description: Native, redirect-free Stripe Connect onboarding for a client's PAYOUT account — the destination that RECEIVES the loan deposit. Replaces the embedded StripeAccountOnboarding flow, which opens connect.stripe.com in a browser window (rejected UX — the goal is Uber-style, the user never leaves the app). The client submits identity/tax/address and a payout destination — a bank account (CLABE) OR a debit card — entirely through native in-app forms; values are tokenized client-side with Stripe.js and forwarded to Stripe via the Account API. REUSE (critical): the debit-card path MUST reuse the existing native card-capture component src/components/SavedCardSetup.tsx (@stripe/react-stripe-js CardElement + client-side tokenization) instead of building a new card form. SavedCardSetup already proves the no-browser pattern for the 'cobros automáticos' charge card; this module applies the SAME pattern to the payout external account. Note the two are DISTINCT Stripe objects: a charge card (Customer PaymentMethod, for being charged installments) is NOT a payout destination (Connect external account, for receiving money) — reuse the UI/tokenization pattern, not the saved object. ARCHITECT REVIEW: REUSES the existing dbo.stripeConnectedAccounts table and dbo.sp_stripe_connectedAccounts stored procedure — NO new tables or columns; only account status (existing columns) is persisted. Also changes stripe_payments.create_connected_account to create Stripe accounts as type='custom' (capability 'transfers') instead of type='express', because only Custom accounts can be onboarded fully via API without a browser redirect.

fields.name: firstName
fields.description: Individual first name. Transmitted to Stripe (Account.individual.first_name); NOT persisted as a new DB column.

fields.name: lastName
fields.description: Individual last name. Transmitted to Stripe (Account.individual.last_name); NOT persisted as a new DB column.

fields.name: dateOfBirth
fields.description: Individual DOB, split into day/month/year for Stripe (Account.individual.dob). NOT persisted as a new DB column.

fields.name: taxId
fields.description: RFC / CURP. Transmitted to Stripe (Account.individual.id_number); NOT persisted as a new DB column.

fields.name: addressLine1
fields.description: Street address. Transmitted to Stripe (Account.individual.address.line1); NOT persisted as a new DB column.

fields.name: addressCity
fields.description: City. Transmitted to Stripe (Account.individual.address.city); NOT persisted as a new DB column.

fields.name: addressState
fields.description: State/province. Transmitted to Stripe (Account.individual.address.state); NOT persisted as a new DB column.

fields.name: addressPostalCode
fields.description: Postal code. Transmitted to Stripe (Account.individual.address.postal_code); NOT persisted as a new DB column.

fields.name: phone
fields.description: Contact phone. Transmitted to Stripe (Account.individual.phone); NOT persisted as a new DB column.

fields.name: acceptedTos
fields.description: The client accepted the Stripe Services Agreement in-app. Sent to Stripe as tos_acceptance (with server-captured date + IP). NOT persisted as a new DB column.

fields.name: payoutMethod
fields.description: Which payout destination the client is linking: 'bank' (CLABE) or 'debit_card'. Both are attached as the Connect external account; a debit card also enables instant payouts. NOT persisted as a new DB column.

fields.name: bankAccountToken
fields.description: When payoutMethod='bank': Stripe.js bank_account token (btok_...) created client-side from the 18-digit CLABE, so the raw account number never reaches the server. Attached via Account.create_external_account. Only the resulting last4/type/bankName are persisted (existing columns).

fields.name: debitCardToken
fields.description: When payoutMethod='debit_card': Stripe.js card token (tok_...) created client-side by REUSING SavedCardSetup's CardElement capture. Attached as the Connect external account via Account.create_external_account for instant payouts. Only last4/brand are persisted (existing columns).

relationships.notes: Multi-tenant isolation via companyId — injected automatically by stored procedures.
One connected account per client (clientId). Reuses dbo.stripeConnectedAccounts.

components.name: IdentityStep
components.description: Native Ionic form collecting firstName, lastName, dateOfBirth, taxId, address fields and an acceptedTos IonCheckbox. On submit ensures the Custom connected account exists, then POST /stripe/connected-accounts/kyc.

components.name: PayoutDestinationStep
components.description: Links the payout destination that RECEIVES the loan deposit, via a segmented choice: (a) Cuenta bancaria — an 18-digit CLABE tokenized with Stripe.js createToken('bank_account'); or (b) Tarjeta de débito — REUSE the existing src/components/SavedCardSetup.tsx CardElement to tokenize a debit card client-side. Then POST /stripe/connected-accounts/bank with the resulting token. MUST NEVER open connect.stripe.com or any browser/iframe — mirror SavedCardSetup's in-app, no-redirect UX. DO NOT reuse the embedded StripeAccountOnboarding component, which redirects to the browser (the behavior being removed).

endpoints.description: MODIFY EXISTING: create the connected account as Stripe type='custom' with capability 'transfers' (was type='express'). Persists initial status via sp_stripe_connectedAccounts (action=upsert). No new columns.

NEW: attach identity/tax/address + ToS to the client's Custom account via stripe.Account.modify(individual=..., tos_acceptance={date, server-captured ip}). Then retrieve the account and persist charges/payouts/details/hasExternalAccount status via sp_stripe_connectedAccounts (action=upsert). Returns { account }.

NEW: attach the tokenized external account via stripe.Account.create_external_account(external_account=<token>, default_for_currency=True). The token is EITHER a bank_account token (btok_, from a CLABE) OR a debit-card token (tok_, from reusing SavedCardSetup's CardElement) — Stripe accepts both as external accounts (debit card = instant payouts). Then retrieve the account and persist externalAccountLast4/Type/BankName + status via sp_stripe_connectedAccounts (action=upsert). Returns { account }.
